narration: You moved eight thousand dollars in credit card debt to a zero-percent deal. Smart move, right? What the bank didn't tell you cost the average person four thousand six hundred dollars.
visual: SVG credit card with '0% APR' badge springs up from bottom. Bold red headline 'THE BALANCE TRANSFER TRAP' fades in. Red $4,600 pill badge pops in below.

narration: Number one — before you saved a dollar in interest, you paid a three percent transfer fee. On eight thousand bucks that's two hundred forty dollars gone on day one, straight to the bank.
visual: Stack of green money bills labeled '$8,000'. Red arrow animates right toward a bank building SVG. '$240 FEE' badge springs into view. Light background.

narration: Number two — read the fine print. Every payment you make goes to the zero percent balance first, not the twenty-two percent purchases you keep charging. It's in the contract.
visual: Two colored columns side by side: green '0% Transfer Balance' column with downward payment arrow, red '22% New Purchases' column with interest counter ticking up. Dark background.

narration: Number three — seventy-three percent of people keep spending on the card anyway. A lower balance feels like breathing room. And just like that, your debt stops going down.
visual: Person silhouette holding two shopping bags. Credit card icon below. Balance counter climbs upward. '73% KEEP SPENDING' stat badge fades in. Light background.

narration: Then month twelve hits and that seventeen percent rate kicks back in. The average person owes more than when they started. That free window cost them four thousand six hundred dollars.
visual: Countdown clock SVG sweeping to zero. Rate display animates from '0%' to '17%' in red. Debt amount counter climbs. 'MONTH 12' badge pulses. Dark background.

narration: Here's the actual move: freeze the card — literally. Pay minimums on the transfer, throw everything extra at new purchases accruing interest right now. Know your exact payoff date before the promo ends.
visual: SVG credit card locked inside an ice cube. Three checklist tips appear one by one: 'Freeze the card', 'Hammer new purchases first', 'Know your payoff date'. Light background.
